local_changes: Portable limits.h, checked strtonum compatibility and getline in place of fgetln.
POSIX.1-2024: preserve empty NUL-delimited arguments; invoke once for empty input unless -r, -I or -L.
Allow -x without -n; trigger line limits only for -L; clamp requested -s to supported maximum.
Portable strlcpy/strlcat and stdint include; cap process limit without signed comparison.
Use fork and close-on-exec errno pipe instead of vfork shared globals; preserve 126/127 on Darwin.
Do not append an empty invocation after a previously executed batch at logical EOF.
Parse arbitrarily large positive -s requests with saturation; enforce strictly less than the supplied byte limit, counting each terminator.
Use memmove when carrying a partial argument to an overlapping buffer and free every replacement argv entry.
